code: The 2026-08-12 SKU zero-write regression was caused by a Harness declaration mismatch: a globally encouraged workMode invalidated the mode-less SKU Manifest, and the unbound Agent then exhausted its 10-tool bootstrap budget before mutation. A Manifest-derived 15-profile declaration catalog, discriminated Resolver, one exact repair and same-response control barrier are now core-validated; three unsafe or incomplete profiles remain explicitly unpublished.

Performance-budget stops now report the actual model/tool/time used and limit; zero-mutation runs explicitly state that no reviewable design exists, while partial-mutation runs remain incomplete until delivery/readback/verification finish. This changes reporting only and does not loosen authorization or Completion.

The real current-app SKU baseline ended after about 20m33s, 24 iterations and 25 model calls with zero Photoshop mutation/output and tool_preflight_blocked; bounded contact-sheet follow-up, document-optional sku-batch entry, executable missing-template repair continuation, delegated-draft provenance and a 16/50/30/420s SKU budget are now core-validated without restarting the user's app.

Agent observation liveness now uses TaskRun and target-revision semantic progress rather than successful read counts; equivalent facts from different Tools have bounded progress credit and cached snapshots do not consume user-visible or visual-model observation budgets.

Canvas and annotated snapshot cache hits are bound to a trusted documentId@historyStateId and carry Runtime-issued object identity; forged or serialized cache markers cannot suppress observation or progress accounting, while writes, exports and document lifecycle changes invalidate reuse.

External document changes now invalidate the old action plan, re-enter existing Runtime stages and require a new R4 plan bound to the observed revision before the same TaskRun writer may resume; old-revision mutation remains rejected and is never auto-replayed.

No-R4 deterministic SKU workflows now acknowledge an exact conflict revision only from a fresh R2 Photoshop observation before E1 resumes; repeated revision drift re-invalidates R2 and downstream evidence, while conflict observedRevision is part of the semantic liveness key.

All cacheable Photoshop document observations share documentId@historyStateId scope; canonical document barriers, active-layer/history changes, project-state writes and project-resource changes invalidate reuse, and cache hits cannot satisfy R2, Stage Trace or user-visible observation/success counts.

The prose and bare-file-extension recovery owner that guessed export or close actions has been retired; structured TaskPlan/Runtime obligations remain authoritative and read failures preserve their exact Host reason.

Design Intelligence Phase 0-6 has been audited by four evidence levels: file/contract existence, pure core validation, isolated Store IO, and product-runtime integration. Phase 2-6 are not product-complete merely because their contracts or Store tests pass.

The autonomous TaskContextBuilder now carries bounded knowledge excerpts, source labels, lifecycle and selection reasons; empty context is not injected, and external Eagle/Web results remain observations or candidates rather than validated knowledge.

Ordinary autonomous tasks do not prefetch Eagle visual candidates; explicit user-pinned references remain in the operating context and the Agent may call Eagle search only when a design decision actually needs it.

The knowledge-library service probes live Eagle MCP separately from local .library browsing and searches independent unified-knowledge and Eagle sources in parallel instead of serially stacking their waits.

The knowledge UI projects the existing MemoryService owner without creating a second learning Store: overview, usable knowledge, human review, task-pinned references, recent use and Eagle dual-channel health are separated in plain language.

PhotoshopTransactionRunner owns renameLayer, groupLayersSafely, setTextStyle, moveLayer and lockLayer target/revision checks, transaction, cancellation, rollback and readback; lockLayer uses explicit document/layer IDs instead of active-target DOM setters.

R-040 containment requires a failed deterministic assertion with a validated blockerKind and safe proofRef before quality may hard-block; ordinary aesthetic and VLM findings project to needs_review across Completion, DesignVerdict, Critic and Reflexion.
Ordinary natural language enters the generic Agent directly; explicit deny-only capability ceilings and execution-point invariants remain deterministic.
Provider raw thinking is a hidden diagnostic source; public model-authored summaries use the controlled design-decision channel.
Universal design principles are task-purpose conditioned; SKU Template, SKU Color Card and SKU Batch have distinct knowledge and task identities.
Without an explicit Evaluation Profile, deterministic checks, VLM judging and final scoring share the task-neutral assertion catalog.
Model-authored Skill parameters cannot mint SKU user authority; filename and inferred color labels retain provisional provenance and SKU notes require trusted explicit scope.
Candidate and no-Skill capability constraints remain deny-wins through candidate inventory, on-demand activation and final execution.

RuntimeSession now owns one minimal TaskRun with stable identity, plan revision, node cursor/status, nonterminal waiting interaction, Host OperationResult refs and document/revision/writer binding; semantic R4 remains shadow and grants no scheduler authority.
Runtime Action Plan remains shadowOnly and non-executable without scheduler authority.

The first governed Photoshop Craft Recipe maps editable single-canvas intent to real Tool semantics, parameter authorities, preservation rules and structure/pixel readback; it is available at R4/R5 and through no-Skill task declaration without execution authority.

Prompt and the Design Agent OS define one professional visual-design and Photoshop production identity as a product boundary without adding a role Runtime contract, task-family enum or Task/Outcome contract chain.
Zero-to-one creation is an intrinsic Design Kernel capability, not an independent Task Type, Skill, Executor, Workflow or generic WorkMode route.

The bounded V0 mutation pack and pack-scoped execution envelope are code-complete and core-validated; they reuse the existing capability map, E1 seam and PhotoshopTransactionRunner, while semantic R4 remains non-executable.

A single exact property replacement with no second mutation, save or export requirement now reuses the existing runtimeAllowedWriteTools ceiling: layer-name edits expose and execute only renameLayer, visible-text edits only setTextContent, and ambiguous property requests only the two candidates until observation resolves them; compound requests remain un-narrowed.

Task Profile, Manifest, Skill and later model declarations cannot expand that request-level write ceiling; the Capability candidate surface and final Agent Tool execution point both enforce it deny-wins.

UXP history position now uses the Photoshop DOM instead of an invalid historyState.count Action get, and audited native get descriptors use dialogOptions=dontDisplay without swallowing structured errors.

Provider failure classification now distinguishes authentication, model access/subscription, billing, rate limit, timeout, network, protocol, upstream service and unknown at the real request boundary; Ollama Cloud settings test the selected model through one minimal real chat request and do not treat the public model-list endpoint as key authentication, while new Run Records retain only a bounded redacted failure digest.

R3 blocking missing input is now user-owned rather than a trigger for renewed observation/search; structured write_photoshop delegation exposes the generic design-execution foundation including removeBackground, and the duplicate recovery owner that guessed Tools from assistant prose has been retired.

Bounded assistant history is now untrusted external draft context rather than a runtime observation; an explicit independent reconsideration excludes old assistant prose while retaining bounded user goals.

A same-document/revision opening observation satisfies cacheable zero-argument reads for the current Run until mutation, target change, cache invalidation or unknown reconciliation makes re-observation necessary.

Structured read-only plans and explicit no-write requests with zero successful mutations no longer receive Photoshop write completion contracts; naked same-product wording no longer implies reference replication, while explicit replication and same-layout/effect wording still does.

Designer decision ownership distinguishes observable facts, reversible professional choices and user-owned or irreversible uncertainty; it does not create a category workflow, permission path or additional runtime owner.

Delegated reversible choices such as arbitrary or common canvas size are no longer treated as missing user input; observe_only unknown-role context permits an independent new document while reuse still prevents target forking.

A real attempted write, export or external generation now creates a delivery obligation even when the early natural-language plan did not predeclare one, so successful observations cannot turn zero successful delivery into completed.

createDocument acceptance now represents absent-before to present-after explicitly and verifies the written document identity, name, dimensions and resolution; mismatched metadata remains a failed assertion.

Transient service-unavailable, network and timeout failures receive at most one same-model retry before any streamed payload; retries never switch models or replay Tools, and final failures carry a truthful failed execution summary.

The existing Agent loop guard owner now reads policyGate from the real ToolResult.output instead of the wrapper, accumulates repeated identical policy gates across interleaved successful reads, stops at five hits, distinguishes different gate codes and excludes human-confirmation HITL results.

Ordinary natural-language runs with no declared taskType now receive the same compact category-neutral Photoshop Craft Recipe set selected by each Recipe's design.generic.v1 applicability marker; the index exposes conditional candidate craft and explicitly forbids treating it as a Tool-probing sequence or restarting project/reference search when the target and source are known.

A declared Task Profile now atomically refreshes the live Runtime Bundle, Capability Session, stage context, Evaluation Profile, Artifact authorization, performance ceiling and generation lineage on the same TaskRun; candidate construction completes before the shared commit boundary.

Creative Completion now hard-checks only factual obligations: real mutation, valid target, post-write same-target readback, explicit copy/no-copy final state and verified editable delivery. Aesthetic findings do not grant or revoke Photoshop permission and unknown evidence remains needs_review.

The final visual Judge has a once-per-generation reserved model, visual, candidate and 90-second time window; score is the sole numeric authority, reliable N/A is assertion-scoped, scoreless review does not pollute coverage, optional Profile checks remain warning-only, and only the three strongest diagnosed findings may drive one completed-after-delivery improvement.

Design Team execution now receives a parent-owned prepartitioned child allowance, role-weighted stage minima, an absolute deadline and atomic revision-route-plus-critic reservation; child usage is observable but never post-deducted from the parent ledger.

A Harness-owned completed-aesthetic-improvement marker survives v5 stage projection: the Session records needs_review reentry to R4 without turning the user's completed delivery into failed or adding a blocker, the outer loop permits that diagnosed route only once, and an E2-bound Runtime requires current-generation structured delivery evidence before the marker can be signed.

Live concurrency/resume validation, real Provider-to-Photoshop V0, live validation of the first Photoshop Craft Recipe, Release Gate, reviewed multi-sample design quality and business live E2E are not complete.

mustDo: Keep the standard Design Agent product identity in Prompt/OS and do not create a role Runtime contract, task-family enum, keyword classifier or role-level Tool whitelist.
